contexts.text: He spoke inwardly in himself.
It is according to order for good... to be within, and truth... without.
The man is then such as he had been within... AC 6495:end.
Within they are devils.
What is deceitful... reigns within, while without he appears... good.
The happiness inwardly in the delights... he regards as nothing.
For something within dissuades (from evil).
Unless he... pays attention to what is going on within him.
When his Intellectual is illumined, it is given him to perceive something inwardly in himself.
The sword without, and the pestilence and famine within ()... For the vastation of truth is without, and that of good within.
The revelation that is made... inwardly in man. Signified.
For that which is within constitutes the essence; and, in the other life, shines through the external.
If the affection of good (is in the speech) it is inwardly soft; if the affection of evil, it is inwardly hard.

They who are enlightened, see and perceive inwardly in themselves whether a thing is true or not. That which is enlightened within, is their Intellectual; and that which is kindled within is their Voluntary. AC 10155:3.
Persuasive faith is not within with a man, but stands without, in the memory only.
Truth without good cannot be said to be within in a man, but is solely in the memory...
The devilishness that is within, then stands forth.
Some believe that the thoughts and affections are (entirely) within them, because they see the things they think inwardly in themselves... but they are much mistaken. Explained.
They were full of eyes within () = ... the Divine wisdom of the Word from the spiritual and celestial senses, which are hidden within.
A book written within and on the back () = ... the Divine wisdom of the Word in every particular, and in every general; within = in every particular... (See AE 299.)
The king's daughter is all precious within () = the affection of spiritual truth; for... within = what is spiritual.
